effects.name: EXPLOSIVE MUNITIONS
effects.text: When the first figure in this group attacks, replace 1 die in the attack pool with 1 red die. If the target is within 3 spaces, replace a blue die first, then yellow, then green. Otherwise, replace a yellow die, then green. That attack gains Blast 1 {H}.

effects.name: HEAVY FIREPOWER
effects.text: When this group attacks, remove 1 red die from the attack pool and add 3 {H} to the attack results.

effects.name: MORTAR
effects.text: The first figure in this group that can affect a Rebel figure performs: {A} Choose a space within 3 spaces that affects the most Rebel figures. Roll 1 red die. Each figure and object on or adjacent to that space suffers {H} equal to the {H} results.

effects.name: RAPID DOMINANCE
effects.text: 2 {T}: The first figure in this group can perform three actions.
